claims.statement: Management targets maintaining same-store sales growth at last financial year's levels.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets passing on sourcing and productivity benefits to customers while keeping gross margins in the 14% to 15% range.
claims.quote: if it is in that ballpark 14% to 15% type of a range, we will pass that on to customers.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects efficiency gains from network consolidation to reflect in FY27 and onwards.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that potential near-term margin trade-offs from tech investments will be very marginal.
claims.quote: No, if at all, they will be very marginal, and therefore I don't think there is something that we would need to flag or highlight at this stage.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Total organized trade including quick commerce and e-commerce is roughly in the early teens.
facts.quote: total organized trade including quick commerce and e-commerce still is roughly in the early teens.

facts.statement: Out of 85 stores opened last fiscal, 15 were leased.
facts.quote: Of the 85 stores that we opened last fiscal, 15 were leased.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts has 68 stores on lease out of over 500 total stores.
facts.quote: we have about 68 stores out of the 500 plus stores that we have now. We have 68 stores which are on lease.

facts.statement: The DMart Ready network currently has 165 pickup points.
